correctness.rationale: PASS: For w=0^a1 0^b1 0^c with a,c>=0 and b>=1, classify MAFs by number of 1s. Unary 0^{L+1} contributes one; one-1 MAFs arise at missing corners of the union of two down-closed rectangles; 1 0^k 1 contributes K gaps excluding k=b, with two conditional wing extensions; the sole possible three-1 MAF is 1 0^b1 0^b1 if a,c>=b. This exhausts possible counts and yields the eight-term indicator formula in RESULT.md, with main term max(b,min(a,c)) and O(1) error. A uniform (a,b,c) composition with b>=1 converges to Dirichlet(1,1,1), so Z=max(Y,min(X,T)) and the CDF is 4t² (t<=1/3), 6t−5t²−1 (1/3..1/2), 2t−t² (1/2..1); integration yields mean 7/18, variance25/648. Independent literal factor-set enumeration tested every admissible triple at lengths n=3,…,14 against exact formula with no mismatch. All-length proof comes from classification, not tests.
residual_risks: Only two nonadjacent ones, b>=1, and uniform conditional composition sampling; excludes neighboring ones and general random binary words.
